title: Excel basics check
task: In Excel for the web, enter 20 rows of sample data, format it as a table, sort and filter it, and add a SUM total. Many admin interviews include a short spreadsheet exercise like this.

title: Outlook and Teams basics
task: In a free Outlook.com account, create a recurring meeting and share your calendar. In free Microsoft Teams, start a chat and share a file.

title: Excel lookups and pivot tables
task: Make a 20-row inventory list in Excel for the web. Use XLOOKUP to pull a supplier name from a second sheet, then build a pivot table of stock by category.

title: Shared folder setup
task: Create a shared Google Drive folder for an imaginary team project with 3 subfolders, a naming rule, and one shared doc. Write down the naming rule so you can explain it.

title: Simple project timeline
task: Build a 5-task timeline with owners and due dates in Google Sheets or the free tier of a project tool. Mark one task late and write a two-line status update about it.

title: Practice your break answer
task: Say your chosen career-break wording out loud three times, then add one sentence on why this role fits you now.
